note: Both sets contain the same invented driveshaft linear-stiffness value of 7,000 N·m/rad and several loosely bound 'drivetrain' attributes, but Set A binds the rated generator speed (1173.7 rpm), generator inertia (534.116 kg·m²) and gearbox ratio (97:1) to the correct components more consistently. Set B adds the DOWEC inertia figures and keeps the conditions on the 0.35 MW power loss, but it also misreads the 5% critical damping ratio as a 'free-free mode natural frequency' and garbles the generator inertia claim as 'generator speed shaft'. Set A omits the rated rotor speed (12.1 rpm) that Set B captures, but overall Set A has fewer misbound or unsupported claims.
